model_annotation: Diagram 1 (left) presents two lines, one representing the Jugendbankindex (Youth Banking Index) and the other representing the Nikkei 225 (an index for Japan's stock market). The x-axis depicts the years from roughly 1950 to 2020, serving as the time scale. The left y-axis measures the Youth Banking Index, which is plotted with a dashed blue line and triangular markers; the y-axis ranges from 0.4 to 2.5 and lacks units. The right y-axis tracks the Nikkei 225 index, which is plotted with a solid red line and circular markers; this axis ranges from 0 to 3 and is associated with rankings or positions. Both lines show an upward trend over time, with the Youth Banking Index showing more volatility, as evidenced by sharp rises and falls throughout the observed period, while the Nikkei 225 exhibits a more steady, albeit still ascendant, increase.
